headline: New Microsoft code models worth a trial, OpenAI pricing drops to assess, and supply chain security to lock down

calls.title: Test Microsoft code models for engineering velocity
calls.text: Test MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash on GitHub Copilot to improve developer velocity for internal data pipeline engineering.

calls.title: Evaluate GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for extraction
calls.text: Evaluate GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on 30 complex private equity fund reports to compare extraction accuracy, latency, and API costs against current production models.

calls.title: Lock down agent dependencies and avoid unverified wrappers
calls.text: Audit and lock down all dependencies used in agentic workflow development following the PyPI agent framework compromise, and avoid unverified third-party prompt logging wrappers.
